$description: ReUI design tokens (W3C Design Tokens format). Source of truth for the island's look; compiled into the reui-design crate. Values are DIPs unless noted. Geometry starts from the Figma 'Dynamic Island - Live Activities' kit, adapted for a desktop without a camera cutout; colours follow Apple's dark system palette. See DESIGN.md.

display.$description: Large text (20+): hero values and numerals

mono.$description: Commands, paths, code; ships with Windows 11

on-accent.$description: Text on a solid white or accent fill

quaternary.$description: The quietest well: a search field that shouldn't outweigh the content

track.$description: Unfilled part of rings, bars and progress

default.$description: Used when an activity doesn't set its own accent

logo.$description: Share of its tile a brand logo fills

glow.$description: Halo under expanded rings; 0 turns it off. A wide translucent stroke reads as blur, not glow, at island sizes

tint-wash.$description: Accent at the top-left corner of a tinted card (music, from the artwork); it fades to nothing by island.expanded.tint-extent of the width

art-stroke.$description: White hairline (1 physical px) just inside image art, so a cover with a black background still shows its edge on the black island

level-dim.$description: A muted level's fill (the level is kept but not in effect); its track stays as it is

meter-fill.$description: The accent filling a compact meter (volume, brightness); the glyph and percentage stay readable over it

typography.$description: Three levels in every expanded view: eyebrow (small, accent) > hero (large, primary) > detail (secondary).

eyebrow.$description: Source or category above the hero, in the accent colour

headline.$description: Hero text when it isn't a number

code.$description: Hero commands and paths, set in a chip

card-text.$description: Wrapped text inside a preview card

card-code.$description: Wrapped code inside a preview card

card-title.$description: Wrapped title inside a card (page titles, file names)

card-label.$description: One-line label inside a card (link host, file name, colour value)

tab.$description: Filter tab labels; their counts use the same style, tabular and quieter

search.$description: Text typed into a search field and its placeholder

note.$description: The one quiet line a panel shows when there is nothing else ("No matches")

lyric.$description: Synced lyrics: the current line in primary ink, the next one under it in secondary

pager.$description: "1/2" between the source switcher's chevrons (tabular, secondary)

tile.$description: Glyph inside an expanded art tile

search.$description: Magnifier at the start of a search field

star.$description: Pinned mark in a card footer

top.$description: Gap between the screen's top edge and the island

height.$description: Idle, compact and minimal height (Apple's island)

width.$description: Resting pill with nothing to show

center-gap.$description: Space between the leading and trailing sides. Apple reserves 126 for the camera; Windows has no cutout, so this only separates the two sides

side-margin.$description: Inset of round content (art, ring, tile) from the pill's ends: a 24 circle sits concentric in the 36.67 capsule

text-margin.$description: Inset of text and bare glyphs from the pill's ends, clear of the end curve

max-side.$description: Longer compact text is ellipsised at this width

peek-grow.$description: Extra width and height while hovered

joined-gap.$description: A text label sits this far after its mark (copied, Caps Lock on, a device). Windows has no camera cutout, so the two read together instead of at the pill's far ends

joined-text.$description: A label beside its mark is ellipsised at this width

meter-width.$description: A level (volume, brightness) takes the whole pill: the pill is the track, the fill grows from the left, the percentage sits at the right end

meter-inset.$description: The meter fill's inset from the pill's edge; its radius is half its height, so it stays concentric with the pill

wide-width.$description: For rich content that asks for it (clipboard cards)

max-height.$description: Apple caps third-party activities at 160 on a phone. A desktop has room for the full music card: inset 20 + header 64 (eyebrow, title, detail) + section gap 16 + timeline with its times 16 + row gap 12 + transport 40 + row gap 12 + volume 32 + row gap 12 + two lyric lines 40 + inset 20 = 284. The clipboard panel needs 244

panel-radius.$description: Corners of the wide panel (clipboard): card radius + inset, so the cards are concentric with it; calmer than the pill's 44

inset.$description: Padding on every side; concentric inner radius = radius - inset = 24

section-gap.$description: Between the header and the first row

tint-extent.$description: Share of the card's width over which a tinted card's accent wash fades out, from the top-left corner

radius.$description: Corners are concentric: anything that sits one inset from the island's edge uses radius - inset, so curves stay parallel.

chip.$description: Code chips and small wells inside text

compact.$description: Circle: concentric with the compact capsule

trailing.$description: Circle: it sits against the island's rounded side

height.$description: Text capsules; radius is height/2, close to radius.concentric

inline.$description: Circular glyph buttons beside the hero

transport.$description: Circular glyph buttons in a full-width row (same as inline)

height.$description: Rich preview cards (clipboard history); four across the wide island

footer.$description: In-card strip: source app icon, age, one fact

media.$description: Share of a link card the page image takes

visible.$description: Cards across the row when they all fit

visible-more.$description: Cards across when there are more: the half card at the edge says the row scrolls

ring-width.$description: Accent hairline on the selected card's edge (with a lighter fill): present, not loud

ring-gap.$description: The hairline sits on the card's edge, so it shares the card's radius

fade.$description: Width of the fade where the card row runs on past the panel's edge

kind-icon.$description: Small type glyph in a card's top-right corner (text, code, link, files)

height.$description: Search field and its buttons; the field is a capsule (16), about the panel's concentric radius (14)

padding.$description: From the field's ends to the magnifier and text; also a text button's side padding

caret.$description: Width of the steady (never blinking) caret while the field has the keyboard

padding.$description: From a tab's ends to its text

count-gap.$description: Between a tab's label and its count

hit-pad.$description: Extra clickable height above and below a seekable bar (timeline and slider)

size.$description: Circle at the end of a seekable bar's fill; shown only while it's hovered or dragged

height.$description: Volume row: glyph buttons at both ends (circles), the bar between

gap.$description: Between a slider's buttons and its bar

hit.$description: Width of each chevron's click target in the source switcher

lines.$description: Lines the lyrics row keeps (current, next), so the card doesn't change height as lines change

width.$description: A level bar (volume, brightness) on a compact side: an accent fill on a track. Sits clear of the end curve like text

height.$description: Same as progress; its radius is height/2

settings.$description: The Settings window (reui-settings): the island's material and type on a normal window. Rows sit in grouped wells separated by gaps (never lines); controls are capsules concentric with their wells.

resize-border.$description: Edge band (inside the window) that resizes it

height.$description: Drag band across the top; the window buttons sit in it

button.$description: Minimise / close: circles, filled only while hovered

inset.$description: Window buttons from the top-right corner
From the window's left edge to the nav capsules

item-padding.$description: From a capsule's start to its label

top.$description: First nav item from the window's top
Page title from the window's top (level with the first nav item)

intro-gap.$description: Between the page title and its paragraph

label-gap.$description: Between a group's eyebrow and its well

height.$description: A row with a one-line description

height-plain.$description: A row with a title only

gap.$description: Gap between rows of a group; the black between them is the separator

radius.$description: Outer corners of a group's well

inner-radius.$description: Corners where two rows of a group meet

line-gap.$description: Between a row's title and description

control-gap.$description: Minimum space between a row's text and its control

height.$description: Buttons, segmented choices, dropdowns, fields, hotkey recorder: capsules

padding.$description: From a capsule's ends to its text

segment-inset.$description: Selected segment inside its track (a concentric capsule)

toggle-inset.$description: Knob inside the track: a circle concentric with the track's end

key-height.$description: Key caps inside the hotkey recorder (concentric with it)

remove.$description: Remove button (circle) on a list item

focus-gap.$description: Ring outside the control, following its radius

padding.$description: Inside the menu, around its items: item radius + padding = menu radius

offset.$description: Below the control that opened it

gap.$description: Between figures in a stat row (About: memory, CPU)

background.$description: The window is the island's material: black

menu.$description: Opaque, a step above the wells: a menu covers the rows under it

toggle.$description: Knob slide; jumps with reduced motion

scroll.$description: Wheel scrolling eases with this time constant

stats.$description: About's idle cost refreshes this often while it shows

row-detail.$description: One quiet line under a row's title

control.$description: Text in buttons, segments, dropdowns, key caps

prefs.$description: The Settings window's second design (reui-settings): macOS System Settings' structure (a sidebar with search and coloured icon tiles, a toolbar, a header card per page, grouped inset forms with hairline separators, footnotes) in ReUI's dark material, with each feature's island drawn in its header. Window sizes, minimums and the resize border stay in settings.window.

sidebar.$description: Solid, a step lighter than the content (no vibrancy)

group.$description: Grouped form containers and the header card

group-edge.$description: Hairline around a container, so it keeps its edge on the content

separator.$description: Hairline between rows of a group, inset from the left

divider.$description: Between sidebar and content; under the toolbar once the page scrolls

selection.$description: The selected sidebar item while the window is active

button.$description: Push buttons, pop-up buttons, key caps

field.$description: Text fields and the search field sit darker than their surface

stage.$description: Where a feature's island is shown: the bottom of the preview's backdrop

mark.$description: The ReUI mark: a light screen with the black island at its top

tile-light.$description: White mixed into an icon tile's top, fading to its colour at the bottom

stage-tint.$description: The page's colour at the top of the island preview's backdrop

section.$description: One colour per page: its icon tile in the sidebar and header, and the tint of its island preview's backdrop

inset.$description: From the sidebar's edges to its items

search-top.$description: The search field, level with the toolbar's title

item-padding.$description: From the highlight's start to the icon tile

label-gap.$description: From the icon tile to the label

height.$description: Drag band over the content: back, forward, the page title, window buttons

button.$description: Back / forward and the window buttons

top.$description: The header card from the window's top (under the toolbar)

label-inset.$description: Section headers and footnotes sit in a little from the container's edge

stage.$description: Height of the island preview at the top of a feature's header card

stage-compact.$description: The same for a preview that only shows compact pills

stage-gap.$description: Between two moments shown side by side on the stage

row.$description: A row with a title only

row-detail.$description: A row with a title and one quiet line

icon.$description: A row's leading icon tile (important rows only)

control-gap.$description: Minimum space between a row's text and its controls

height.$description: Push buttons, pop-up buttons, segmented controls, fields, shortcut recorder

slider-reading.$description: The value left of a slider ("2 %")

hover.$description: Hover fills ease in and out with this time constant (settled in about 120 ms), at the display's refresh

wheel.$description: Wheel notches ease to their target with this time constant; touchpad deltas apply directly

enter.$description: A feature's island preview settles in when its page opens, once; still after that

toolbar.$description: The page title in the toolbar

control.$description: Buttons, segments, pop-ups, key caps, menu items

reduced.$description: Used for everything when Windows animations are off

damping-offset.$description: Height settles slightly calmer than width

collapse.$description: After the pointer leaves an expanded island

hover-intent.$description: Pointer must rest this long before the pill takes clicks; quicker moves and clicks reach what's underneath (browser tabs)

decision-hold.$description: A decision that opened itself folds back to compact (still pending) if not engaged

panel-idle.$description: A card opened with a hotkey (clipboard history) stays until dismissed, or this long untouched

reveal-hold.$description: In a hidden visibility mode, how long the island stays after the pointer leaves it once revealed from the top edge

fade.$description: Opacity part of showing and hiding (shorter than the motion so the shape leads)

logo.$description: Working animation of brand logos: a quick eased quarter turn every interval, still in between. Continuous spinning cost DWM ~21% of a core; ticks only make it work during the turn

show.$description: The island emerging from (and retracting into) the top edge when its visibility changes

rise.$description: How far above its resting place the island starts / ends

compact-out.$description: Compact content is gone after 1/4 of the expansion

expanded-in-start.$description: Expanded content starts fading in at this progress

lyrics.$description: A new lyric line: the column slides up one line (the sung one fades out above, the next brightens into place), on a short timer that stops when it lands

scroll.$description: A scrolling card row eases to its target, driven by a short timer that stops once it settles (no idle cost)

time-constant.$description: Exponential approach: about 95% of the way after three of these

level.$description: A level (volume, brightness) eases to a new value, ease-out, on a short timer that stops when it lands, so a run of key presses reads as one movement. A new activity's first value and reduced motion jump

bars.$description: Level bars move while something plays. The island drives them itself at a fixed rate instead of a compositor animation: DWM then only redraws when they change (30 times a second) rather than every display frame

attack.$description: Real visualizer: how fast a bar rises to a louder band (time constant)

release.$description: Real visualizer: how slowly a bar falls back (time constant)
